explain.say: The phone in your pocket is more powerful than the computers that sent astronauts to the Moon. But how did we get here? Let us walk along the timeline together. Look at the first point: the abacus, beads on rods used for thousands of years from Mesopotamia to China and Japan.

faq.a: It depends what you count. The abacus helped people calculate thousands of years ago, Babbage designed a mechanical computer in 1837, and early electronic computers like Colossus and ENIAC were built in the 1940s.
asks: When was the first computer made?

faq.a: Ada Lovelace, an English mathematician, published steps in 1843 for Babbage's Analytical Engine to work out Bernoulli numbers, and is often called the first computer programmer.

faq.q: Why did computers get so small?
faq.a: The microchip, invented in 1958, put many transistors on one small piece of silicon. Engineers kept making transistors smaller, so more fitted on each chip.

faq.q: How big were the first computers?
faq.a: Very big. ENIAC, finished in 1945, filled a large room, weighed about 27 tonnes and used about 18,000 vacuum tubes.

faq.q: When did people get computers at home?
faq.a: Home computers took off in the late 1970s and 1980s, and the World Wide Web from 1991 made home internet popular in the 1990s.
asks: When did the internet start for families?

facts: Ada Lovelace published what is often called the first computer program in 1843.
ENIAC weighed about 27 tonnes and used about 18,000 vacuum tubes.
Jack Kilby demonstrated the first integrated circuit in 1958.

quiz.say: Who wrote steps for the Analytical Engine and is often called the first programmer?
quiz.show: The first programmer is often said to be…
quiz.why: Ada Lovelace published her program for the Analytical Engine in 1843.

wrong.1: Jack Kilby invented the microchip in 1958.
wrong.2: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web.

quiz.why: ENIAC was built in 1945, long before the web in 1991 and smartphones in the 2000s.

wrong.1: The web came in 1991, after ENIAC.
wrong.2: Smartphones spread from 2007, the latest of the three.
